eventScripts.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("AlarmTest")
	
	parsedJson = currentValue.value
	
	tagPaths = []
	tagValues = []
	
	for i in range(min(len(parsedJson), 5)):
	
	    alarmData = parsedJson[i]
	
	    alarmGroupID = alarmData["AlarmGroupID"]
	    alarmCode = alarmData["AlarmCode"]
	    active = alarmData["Active"]
	
	    alarm = AlarmConfig.AlarmMessages_1.getAlarm(alarmGroupID, alarmCode)
	
	    if alarm:
	
	        tagPaths.extend([
	            "[.]Operator_Msg_{}".format(i),
	            "[.]Label_{}".format(i),
	            "[.]Troubleshoot_{}".format(i),
	            "[.]Active_{}".format(i)
	        ])
	
	        tagValues.extend([
	            alarm["OperatorMessage"],
	            alarm["Label"],         
	            alarm["Troubleshoot"],
	            active
	        ])
	
	if tagPaths:
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, tagValues)

if currentValue.value and not previousValue.value:
		logger = system.util.getLogger("AlarmLookup")
		
		groupId = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]AlarmGroupID_0"])[0].value
		alarmCode = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]AlarmCode_0"])[0].value
		
		logger.info("Group = {}".format(groupId))
		logger.info("Code  = {}".format(alarmCode))
		
		alarm = AlarmConfig.AlarmMessages.getAlarm(groupId, alarmCode)
		
		logger.info("Alarm = {}".format(alarm))
		
		if alarm:
		    logger.info("Description = {}".format(alarm["description"]))
		
		    qv = system.tag.writeBlocking(
		        ["[.]Operator_Msg_0"],
		        [alarm["description"]]
		    )
		
		    logger.info("Write Result = {}".format(qv))
		else:
		    logger.warn("Alarm not found in dictionary")
